Members also discussed special revenue funds and ideas for future meetings, then adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no votes; it heard FY24 budget presentations and reviewed the draft warrant articles.
The town finance director walked through the draft warrant articles, including the omnibus budget, enterprise funds, stabilization funds and new funding articles.
The Sewer Commission, through the DPW director, presented a budget in which revenues fall short of expenditures and retained earnings cover the gap.
Public Access presented its FY24 budget, with franchise income from Comcast estimated from recent quarters and a warning that cable cutting may reduce it.
The committee set next steps: a public hearing next week, recommendation votes likely deferred, and capital plan numbers to be sent before the March 30 meeting.

why_it_matters: The sewer budget leans on retained earnings to close its gap, which bears on future sewer user charges and on what town meeting is asked to approve.
The committee's recommendations on the warrant articles are likely to come after the public hearing, so residents have a window to comment before town meeting.
watch_next: Public hearing on the warrant articles next week, with a general meeting April 6 and a possible second hearing April 20.
Capital plan numbers due to members before the March 30 meeting.
